description: An input class that config/strictly.php declares for a vendor action (the Kit's LoginData, for Fortify's login), saved mid-edit so that it parses but can't be loaded, fails generation naming the class, its file and the load error, instead of crashing with a stack trace while the vendor declarations are checked.

expect.errorContains: app/Data/Auth/LoginData.php: App\Data\Auth\LoginData can't be loaded: Class "App\Data\Auth\InputDat" not found
